decisions.finalAnswer: Damaged stock should be disposed of. Include the €2,000 quoted cost only if the damage creates a present legal or constructive disposal obligation at 31 August; otherwise disclose the expected future cost and exclude the provision.
decisions.reviewExplanation: The €2,000 quote measures the expected removal cost but does not itself establish a liability. The selected provision assumes the water-damaged stock must be removed under an existing obligation; verify the rule, commitment or order before finalising.
